company.name: CHEFS CULINAR (CHEFS CULINAR Ost)
company.distributes: Food and non-food wholesale for catering, around 25,000 lines.
company.channels_supplied: Hotels, gastronomy, company and communal catering; eastern region served from Zorbau (Saxony-Anhalt), about 50 km from Jena. Jena customers inferred, not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Family run full range supplier stocking around 25,000 products from 8 sites and 23 depots.
company.fit_rationale: A family run delivered foodservice wholesaler whose eastern depot is within easy reach of Jena. Useful for sugar free syrups and portion snacks in hotels and canteens, but foodservice is secondary for Diablo.

company.name: dennree GmbH
company.distributes: Around 10,000 to 13,000 organic food lines plus natural cosmetics and drugstore items.
company.channels_supplied: Over 1,500 independent organic specialist shops in Germany, Austria and Luxembourg plus its own Denns BioMarkt stores; Jena delivery is inferred from national coverage and its base about 90 km away.
what_they_do_well: Founded as a one-person business in 1974 and now supplies over 1,500 organic specialist stores.
company.fit_rationale: Reaches organic shops in and around Jena from a nearby Upper Franconia base. Its organic only range is the main barrier, so it is only relevant for any certified organic Diablo lines.

company.name: Lekkerland SE
company.distributes: Sweets, savoury snacks, ice cream, fresh food, soft and alcoholic drinks, tobacco, own brand lines and non-food for on-the-go retail.
company.channels_supplied: Petrol station shops, kiosks, convenience stores, drinks specialist stores, DIY stores and organised foodservice; Central Germany including the Jena area is served from its Borna (Leipzig) logistics centre.
what_they_do_well: Serves around 60,000 sales outlets from 14 German logistics centres.
Borna centre supplies about 3,400 petrol station, kiosk and drinks store customers across Central Germany.
company.fit_rationale: The dominant wholesaler into German petrol stations and kiosks, the main impulse channel for sweets and snacks around Jena. A listing would put Diablo bars and sweets in front of thousands of outlets at once. It is a large REWE group business, so expect a formal category listing process rather than an owner decision.

company.name: Transgourmet Deutschland (Selgros Erfurt)
company.distributes: Cash and carry and delivered wholesale food and non-food, around 68,000 lines in the stores.
company.channels_supplied: Trade customers including retailers, gastronomy and caterers via the Selgros store in Erfurt (An der Flurscheide) and delivery depots.
what_they_do_well: Transgourmet Germany serves about 32,500 delivery customers with around 37,000 articles from 13 sites.
company.fit_rationale: Second cash and carry option for Jena area retailers and caterers, with the nearest store in Erfurt. Same central listing hurdle as METRO, so a lower priority than specialist importers.
